channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s economy faces long road to recovery as fragile truce tested
item.description: The devastation that industrial facilities have taken from two wars in a year might take years to reverse, say analysts.

item.title: Khamenei’s coffin arrives in Iraq as US strikes hit Iran
item.description: The coffin carrying Iran’s late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei has arrived in one of Shia Islam’s holiest cities, Najaf.

item.title: Oil surges as US strikes Iran, reversing return to pre-war prices
item.description: Brent crude rises above $76 a barrel for the first time in two weeks amid renewed violence in Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: US immigration officer shoots and kills man in Texas
item.description: Man, identified as Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, is latest to be killed by ICE officers since President Trump took power.

item.title: US strikes Iran despite promised pause for Khamenei funeral
item.description: The US launches new strikes on Iran despite a promise by US President Donald Trump to pause attacks.

item.title: How the US-Iran conflict is reshaping Africa’s geopolitical opportunities
item.description: The US-Israel war on Iran is forcing African governments to rethink their security and economic priorities.

item.title: Iran war live: Sirens in Bahrain, Kuwait as Tehran responds to US attacks
item.description: Iran says it targeted '85 military installations' in Bahrain and Kuwait in retaliation for US strikes on its south.

item.title: Russian missiles strike Ukraine’s capital, Kyiv, for third time in a week
item.description: The attacks have triggered fires in two districts of Kyiv, according to the city's mayor.

item.title: US and Iran trade strikes after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The US military says it hit missile sites and command centres while Iran says it attacked US bases.

item.title: Lawyer says detained Gaza doctor was severely beaten in Israeli jail
item.description: The lawyer for Dr Hussam Abu Safiya tells the BBC his client was so badly beaten he could not recognise him during a visit last week.
